# Cocaine releases

> Cocaine is a macOS menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake for a set time, with an optional mouse and trackpad scroll reverser. This repository hosts only the release zips (current version 1.3, 2026-10-09); the source is not public. Installed copies check this repository's releases once a day and update themselves.

- Install: download `Cocaine-<version>.zip` from the latest release, unzip, move `Cocaine.app` to Applications, right-click and choose Open the first time (the app is not notarized).
- Copies on version 1.2 can't see updates and need one manual install of 1.3.
- There is no Homebrew cask for Cocaine.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/QuentinCar0n/cocaine-releases/blob/main/README.md): what Cocaine is, install, how updates work, FAQ
- [Releases](https://github.com/QuentinCar0n/cocaine-releases/releases): release notes and zips for every version

## Optional

- [QuentinCar0n Homebrew tap](https://github.com/QuentinCar0n/homebrew-tap): Homebrew casks for the same author's macOS apps
- [MultiClaude](https://github.com/QuentinCar0n/multiclaude): another macOS menu bar app by the same author
